verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own Edge product, a lightweight caching and relay layer. It acts as a read replica for thousands of SDKs, evaluates targeting data such as PII within the Edge node, and keeps working when disconnected from upstream. The evidence does not show deployment close to users for latency, or flag evaluation in CDN workers, so story coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented CDN-worker or serverless edge evaluation, explicit guidance on deploying Edge geographically near users for low latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: Unleash Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer designed to improve scalability, performance, and resilience.
functioning as a read replica that can handle thousands of connected SDKs without increasing the read load on your primary Unleash instance
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
Edge is designed to survive restarts and maintain functionality even if you lose connection to your Unleash server.
